subject: [hw] DONE opus-ios: selftest + probe + vcodecd iOS build, rootfs transaction vcodec (VM-rehearsed, catalog clean)
body: Host-only; nothing ran on the phone. bash gpu/hwcodec/ios/test/run_tests.sh -> N2TEST opus-ios PASS 18/18 (selftest T1-T5 on the PC incl. real vendor set to M-c; probe end-to-end against vcodecd test build; refusals). bash gpu/hwcodec/ios/build.sh -> IOS TOOLS OK (n2vcd_selftest, n2vcd_probe, vcodecd; arm64 iOS 16, ad-hoc, libSystem only). Transaction files: gpu/build/apps-20261104/{stage-vcodec.sh,guest-vcodec.sh,guest-vcodec-undo.sh,owned-vcodec.json,owned-vcodec-undo.json,rehearse-vcodec.sh,vcodec_check.py}; payload-vcodec staged as vc1-selftest (selftest gate only; needs no kernel change). generic_update_offline VM rehearsal on the mirror overlay: CC_JOB_ADDED 532->534, receipt in step, fsck OK, catalog 17 changed paths, 0 outside owned. Fake-root rehearsal (real launchd.plist): install, idempotent, foreign-file refusal, undo -> launchd.plist byte-identical. Vendor objects: /usr/local/lib/n2vendor/{bin,lib} (hard-linked from cam-vendor vfs into the payload, sha256-pinned, never committed). Jobs: com.nord2.vcodec-selftest, com.nord2.vcodecd, com.nord2.vcodec-probe; gates /private/var/db/nord2-vcodec-{selftest,run,probe}; logs N2VCDT/N2VCD/N2VCDP on /dev/console.
